title: LaPaz studies green fireballs following nuclear debris
place_text: University of New Mexico; United States

tellings.quote: in 1948 49 he was basically studying green Fireballs following the plume radioactive debris post nuclear blasts across the US

plain: In 1948 and 1949, Lincoln LaPaz of the University of New Mexico was 'basically studying green fireballs', bright green lights seen in the sky, which appeared to follow the plume of radioactive debris drifting across the US after nuclear blasts. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a sign that the lights were drawn to nuclear activity.
